goal: Ensures sufficient sample size for statistically valid estimates
description: Validates the number of instances of an entity to achieve adequate statistical power.

qualityDimensions.source: Biessmann, F., Golebiowski, J., Rukat, T., Lange, D., Schmidt, P.: Automated data validation in machine learning systems. IEEE Data Eng. Bull. 44, 51–65 (2021)

statement: In the AMRStudy.isolates entity, the number of instances must be at least 2000
